name: CONROY, the Hon. Patrick (Pat) Martin

headline.note: Coles is the only documented private-enterprise employer, but the official record provides year-only boundaries and no substantive full-time evidence. Political staff, unions, party activity, study and elected office are excluded under the codebook. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official occupation extract records customer-service work at Coles from 1995 to 2000. Store, employing legal entity, exact dates, hours, leave and overlap with university study are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but no exact substantive full-time interval is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: Current government and secondary biographies identify the Economics honours degree. Enrolment/completion dates, load and overlap with Coles or early political work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Study is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Australian Labor Party and Australian Young Labor
career_spells.role: Member from 1994; state and federal Young Labor vice-president, 2003–2004
career_spells.evidence_note: Secondary material drawing on the parliamentary biography and maiden speech records ALP membership from 1994 and Young Labor vice-presidential roles from 2003 to 2004. Exact terms, pay, hours and overlap with paid work are unresolved; governance is not assumed to be employment.
career_spells.counting_note: Party activity is excluded under the codebook.

research_notes: The frozen occupation extract provides a continuous year-level sequence from 1995 to federal entry but not exact transitions or hours.
Union and political-staff employment are preserved separately and excluded from the narrow public/private headline under the approved codebook.
Customer-service, economist and senior political titles are not treated as proof of substantive full-time status.
Ministerial and electorate changes after 2013 are nested within federal elected service.
